sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • FOMC Decision Day (announced at 14:00 ET) + Warsh Debut: This is the first rate meeting chaired by Kevin Warsh after replacing Powell. The market almost unanimously expects rates to remain unchanged, with all focus on the dot plot and wording around the future path. As of 13:34, SPY was near 750, up slightly by about 0.1%; QQQ strengthened on semiconductors, while DIA and IWM diverged. Ahead of the decision, the entire market was “pinned down” in a narrow range.
  • Trump’s marathon G7 press conference dominated market sentiment: Before the decision, the president delivered an impromptu speech at the G7 in France that lasted more than an hour and was described by the community as an “information entropy explosion” — jumping illogically from bombing Iran, “being born with a machine gun in his hand,” comparing himself to Lincoln as “Honest Abe,” to oil prices, eggs, donuts, and granite. The community broadly interpreted it as “using continuous talking to hold the market in place until FOMC,” leaving put holders with no way to act.
  • 60-day delay uncertainty emerges around the U.S.-Iran “Memorandum of Understanding (MOU)”: The agreement that the market had originally expected to be signed this week was pushed back after Trump said he was “not bound by the agreement” and that if no deal was reached within 60 days, bombing would resume. The community is highly alert to a “fake pump, real dump / financial repression” narrative, though oil prices remained unusually calm.
  • “BAG7” mega-cap tech stocks sold off collectively: MSFT fell to around 383, approaching the 380 level (the community noted it was “20% higher just 16 days ago”); META/AMZN/GOOGL/NFLX also sold off in tandem to intraday lows. Concerns over AI capex are the main theme. Meanwhile, SPY/QQQ remained near all-time highs, and the split between “index highs vs. the Seven Giants at 52-week lows” became the biggest confusion of the day.
  • Semiconductors/memory strengthened independently: MU defended 1060, with the community shouting for a move to 1200; AVGO, MRVL, WDC, NBIS and others continued the “sell software, buy hardware” rotation, while XLK rose despite BAG7 weakness.
  • SPCX (SpaceX) fizzled after options launch: It fell below 200 intraday, touched around 187, then rebounded. The community declared that the “short squeeze is dead and IV decay has begun,” mocking IPO high-price bagholders.

社区氛围：今天的社区处于一种不安、愤世嫉俗、躁狂的混乱状态——被迫等待决策而感到无聊，对总统“胡言乱语操纵市场”的黑色幽默抱怨，以及对 BAG7 持续走低的绝望，所有这些都堆积在一起。多头和空头都感觉受到了市场的操纵（“看涨期权10%未卖出变成-25%，与看跌期权相同”），整体情绪更倾向于毫无方向的赌徒发泄，而不是任何明确的看涨或看跌立场。

恐惧/贪婪：中性，但有混乱的倾向。 VIX因FOMC而上涨，IV“先抽后压”后又被用来收割0DTE玩家；然而，社区中并没有出现系统性恐慌，更多的是对单一群体（BAG7）的局部绝望以及对半导体/HOOD 的局部贪婪。

情绪与实际市场走势：社区的强烈情绪与指数的“死水”行为形成鲜明对比。大盘几乎没有变动；所有的戏剧性事件都集中在内部部门轮换（半导体 W 与软件崩溃）和总统新闻发布会的喜剧效果上，而不是真正的指数波动。
